verdict.rationale: Exa's docs say its MCP server is open source and on GitHub, and the exa-js SDK repo is public on GitHub. Only these peripheral client and integration pieces are evidenced as readable; nothing shows the core search or index service is open. Missing for 10: open-source core search/index engine, a named license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the MCP server and SDK, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
